function fmtCompact(n, suffix = "") {
  if (Math.abs(n) >= 1_000_000) return `${(n / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)}M${suffix}`;
  if (Math.abs(n) >= 1000) return `${(n / 1000).toFixed(1)}k${suffix}`;
  return `${Math.round(n).toLocaleString("en-US")}${suffix}`;
}

function fmtHours(n) {
  return fmtCompact(n, " h");
}

function fmtPct(n) {
  return `${(n * 100).toFixed(1)}%`;
}

function statusColor(status) {
  if (/usable/i.test(status)) return { fill: C.tealSoft, text: C.teal };
  if (/not supported/i.test(status)) return { fill: C.redSoft, text: C.red };
  if (/partial/i.test(status)) return { fill: C.amberSoft, text: C.amber };
  return { fill: C.blueSoft, text: C.blue };
}

async function writeBlob(filePath, blob) {
  await fs.writeFile(filePath, new Uint8Array(await blob.arrayBuffer()));
}

function addShape(slide, position, fill = C.card, line = C.line, radius = "rounded-xl") {
  return slide.shapes.add({
    geometry: "roundRect",
    position,
    fill,
    line: { style: "solid", fill: line, width: 1 },
    borderRadius: radius,
    shadow: "shadow-sm",
  });
}

function addText(slide, text, position, style = {}) {
  const shape = slide.shapes.add({
    geometry: "textbox",
    position,
    fill: "none",
    line: { style: "solid", fill: "none", width: 0 },
  });
  shape.text = text;
  shape.text.style = {
    fontFace: "Aptos",
    fontSize: style.fontSize ?? 18,
    bold: style.bold ?? false,
    color: style.color ?? C.body,
    alignment: style.alignment ?? "left",
  };
  return shape;
}

    left: 805,
    top: 26,
    width: 420,
    height: 22,

}

}

function addCardHeader(slide, x, y, w, title, subtitle = "") {
  addText(slide, title, { left: x + 24, top: y + 18, width: w - 48, height: 26 }, {
    fontSize: 19,
    bold: true,
    color: C.ink,
  });
  if (subtitle) {
    addText(slide, subtitle, { left: x + 24, top: y + 46, width: w - 48, height: 22 }, {
      fontSize: 12,
      color: C.muted,
    });
  }
}

function addChartCard(slide, x, y, w, h, title, subtitle = "") {
  addShape(slide, { left: x, top: y, width: w, height: h }, C.card);
  addCardHeader(slide, x, y, w, title, subtitle);
  return { left: x + 34, top: y + 82, width: w - 68, height: h - 108 };
}

function addInsightCard(slide, x, y, w, h, title, body, accent = C.blue) {
  addShape(slide, { left: x, top: y, width: w, height: h }, C.card);
  slide.shapes.add({
    geometry: "rect",
    position: { left: x + 24, top: y + 24, width: 10, height: 10 },
    fill: accent,
    line: { style: "solid", fill: accent, width: 0 },
  });
  addText(slide, title, { left: x + 44, top: y + 18, width: w - 68, height: 26 }, {
    fontSize: 18,
    bold: true,
    color: C.ink,
  });
  addText(slide, body, { left: x + 24, top: y + 56, width: w - 48, height: h - 74 }, {
    fontSize: 15,
    color: C.body,
  });
}

function addTable(slide, rows, columns, position, columnWidths, options = {}) {
  const table = slide.tables.add({
    rows: rows.length,
    columns,
    left: position.left,
    top: position.top,
    width: position.width,
    height: position.height,
    values: rows,
    columnWidths,
  });
  table.styleOptions = { headerRow: true, bandedRows: false };
  table.borders.assign({ style: "solid", fill: C.line, width: 1 });
  for (let c = 0; c < columns; c += 1) {
    const cell = table.getCell(0, c);
    cell.fill = C.cardAlt;
    cell.textStyle.bold = true;
    cell.textStyle.fontSize = options.headerSize ?? 12;
    cell.textStyle.color = C.ink;
  }
  for (let r = 1; r < rows.length; r += 1) {
    for (let c = 0; c < columns; c += 1) {
      const cell = table.getCell(r, c);
      cell.fill = r % 2 === 0 ? C.cardAlt : C.card;
      cell.textStyle.fontSize = options.bodySize ?? 11;
      cell.textStyle.color = C.body;
    }
  }
  return table;
}

function addReadinessRow(slide, x, y, w, topic, status, implication) {
  const colors = statusColor(status);
  addShape(slide, { left: x, top: y, width: w, height: 82 }, C.card, C.line, "rounded-lg");
  addText(slide, topic, { left: x + 18, top: y + 16, width: 210, height: 24 }, {
    fontSize: 15,
    bold: true,
    color: C.ink,
  });
  slide.shapes.add({
    geometry: "roundRect",
    position: { left: x + 246, top: y + 16, width: 142, height: 26 },
    fill: colors.fill,
    line: { style: "solid", fill: colors.fill, width: 0 },
    borderRadius: "rounded-full",
  });
  addText(slide, status, { left: x + 256, top: y + 20, width: 122, height: 18 }, {
    fontSize: 10,
    bold: true,
    color: colors.text,
    alignment: "center",
  });
  addText(slide, implication, { left: x + 414, top: y + 14, width: w - 440, height: 54 }, {
    fontSize: 13,
    color: C.body,
  });
}

async function main() {
  await fs.mkdir(OUT_DIR, { recursive: true });
  await fs.mkdir(PREVIEW_DIR, { recursive: true });
  await fs.mkdir(LAYOUT_DIR, { recursive: true });

  const payload = JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(PAYLOAD_JSON, "utf-8"));
  const d = payload.snapshot.datasets;
  const kpi = Array.isArray(d.kpi_overall) ? d.kpi_overall[0] : d.kpi_overall;
  const fleetMix = d.fleet_mix;
  const topMix = d.top_robot_time_mix;
  const rankings = d.robot_rankings;
  const scatter = d.robot_scatter;
  const readiness = d.data_quality;

  const topIdleLabels = [...new Set(topMix.map((r) => r.robot_label))];
  const idleByRobot = topIdleLabels.map((label) => topMix.find((r) => r.robot_label === label && r.time_type === "Idle")?.hours ?? 0);
  const travelByRobot = topIdleLabels.map((label) => topMix.find((r) => r.robot_label === label && r.time_type === "Travel")?.hours ?? 0);

  const highCoverage = scatter
    .filter((r) => r.observed_hours >= 1000)
    .sort((a, b) => (b.idle_share * b.observed_hours) - (a.idle_share * a.observed_hours))
    .slice(0, 6);

  const presentation = Presentation.create({ slideSize: { width: W, height: H } });

  // Slide 1: report overview like the interactive artifact.
  {
    const slide = setupSlide(presentation, "01");
    addReportTitle(
      slide,
      "INTERACTIVE REPORT SUMMARY",
      "Idle dominates the observed robot fleet time",
      "Full available ODS status window from 2025-09-15 to 2026-06-29. Queue duration remains a data-readiness item because the reviewed ODS/DWD fields do not expose a reliable end timestamp or populated duration.",
    );
    addMetricCard(slide, 56, 318, 268, "Observed hours", fmtCompact(kpi.observed_hours), `${fmtCompact(kpi.status_sample_count)} status intervals`, C.blue);
    addMetricCard(slide, 346, 318, 268, "Idle share", fmtPct(kpi.idle_share), `${fmtHours(kpi.idle_hours)} idle hours`, C.orange);
    addMetricCard(slide, 636, 318, 268, "Travel share", fmtPct(kpi.travel_share), `${fmtHours(kpi.travel_hours)} travel hours`, C.teal);
    addMetricCard(slide, 926, 318, 268, "Robots observed", String(kpi.robot_count), `${fmtCompact(kpi.large_gap_count)} gaps >300s excluded`, C.amber);
    addInsightCard(
      slide,
      56,
      480,
      548,
      126,
      "What this report can support today",
      "Idle and travel duration are decision-ready as proxy metrics derived from valid adjacent ODS status intervals. They are suitable for robot-level prioritization and fleet utilization review.",
      C.teal,
    );
    addInsightCard(
      slide,
      636,
      480,
      558,
      126,
      "What should not be over-read yet",
      "Queue time should stay out of KPI decisions until a queue end timestamp or trusted duration field is populated in the ODS/DWD path.",
      C.red,
    );
  }

  // Slide 2: fleet time mix.
  {
    const slide = setupSlide(presentation, "02");
    addSectionHeader(slide, "FLEET MIX", "Valid observed time is mostly idle", "Idle/travel is calculated from adjacent status samples and excludes intervals longer than 300 seconds.");
    const frame = addChartCard(slide, 56, 184, 742, 424, "Fleet time mix", "Full available ODS status window; valid intervals only.");
    slide.charts.add("bar", {
      position: frame,
      categories: fleetMix.map((r) => r.time_type),
      series: [{ name: "Hours", values: fleetMix.map((r) => r.hours), fill: C.orange }],
      barOptions: { direction: "column", grouping: "clustered", gapWidth: 68 },
      hasLegend: false,
      yAxis: { majorGridlines: { style: "solid", fill: C.line, width: 1 }, numberFormatCode: "#,##0" },
      xAxis: { textStyle: { fill: C.muted, fontSize: 12 } },
      dataLabels: { showValue: false },
      chartFill: "none",
      plotAreaFill: "none",
    });
    addInsightCard(slide, 830, 184, 362, 126, "Meaning", "Idle is not a small residual. It is the dominant operating state in the reviewed telemetry.", C.orange);
    addInsightCard(slide, 830, 334, 362, 126, "Operational question", "The next review should focus on dispatching, task availability, queueing, and waiting states that leave valid observed time unused.", C.blue);
    addInsightCard(slide, 830, 484, 362, 124, "Metric caveat", "Travel is a speed-threshold proxy, not a route-level travel-duration table.", C.amber);
  }

  // Slide 3: top idle robots.
  {
    const slide = setupSlide(presentation, "03");
    addSectionHeader(slide, "ROBOT COMPARISON", "High idle hours concentrate in a few high-coverage AMRs", "The ranking uses robot-level ODS status rollups sorted by idle hours.");
    const frame = addChartCard(slide, 56, 184, 742, 424, "Top idle robots: idle vs travel hours", "Top 8 robots ranked by idle hours.");
    slide.charts.add("bar", {
      position: frame,
      categories: topIdleLabels,
      series: [
        { name: "Idle", values: idleByRobot, fill: C.orange },
        { name: "Travel", values: travelByRobot, fill: C.blue },
      ],
      barOptions: { direction: "column", grouping: "stacked", gapWidth: 44 },
      legend: { position: "bottom", overlay: false },
      yAxis: { majorGridlines: { style: "solid", fill: C.line, width: 1 }, numberFormatCode: "#,##0" },
      xAxis: { textStyle: { fill: C.muted, fontSize: 10 } },
      dataLabels: { showValue: false },
      chartFill: "none",
      plotAreaFill: "none",
    });
    addShape(slide, { left: 830, top: 184, width: 362, height: 424 }, C.card);
    addCardHeader(slide, 830, 184, 362, "Robot utilization detail", "Robot-level rollup sorted by idle hours.");
    const rows = [
      ["Robot", "Idle h", "Idle %", "Band"],
      ...[...rankings].sort((a, b) => b.idle_hours - a.idle_hours).slice(0, 7).map((r) => [
        r.robot_label,
        Math.round(r.idle_hours).toString(),

        r.utilization_band,
      ]),
    ];
    addTable(slide, rows, 4, { left: 854, top: 266, width: 314, height: 262 }, [74, 70, 64, 106], { bodySize: 10, headerSize: 11 });
    addText(slide, "AMR 13 and AMR 11 both exceed 90% idle share while carrying thousands of observed hours.", {
      left: 854,
      top: 548,
      width: 314,
      height: 40,
    }, { fontSize: 13, color: C.body });
  }

  // Slide 4: same chart concept as the JSON report, with no point labels to avoid overlap.
  {
    const slide = setupSlide(presentation, "04");
    addSectionHeader(slide, "OPPORTUNITY POOL", "Coverage separates real opportunities from small-sample extremes", "Each point is one AMR; high-coverage, high-idle robots are the main opportunity pool.");
    const frame = addChartCard(slide, 56, 184, 742, 424, "Robot coverage vs idle share", "Labels are kept in the table to avoid overlap in the scatter plot.");
    const high = scatter.filter((r) => /High coverage/i.test(r.activity_class));
    const other = scatter.filter((r) => !/High coverage/i.test(r.activity_class));
    slide.charts.add("scatter", {
      position: frame,
      series: [
        {
          name: "High observation",
          xValues: high.map((r) => r.observed_hours),
          values: high.map((r) => r.idle_share),
          marker: { symbol: "circle", size: 7 },
          fill: C.orange,
          line: { style: "solid", fill: "none", width: 0 },
        },
        {
          name: "Other robots",
          xValues: other.map((r) => r.observed_hours),
          values: other.map((r) => r.idle_share),
          marker: { symbol: "circle", size: 6 },
          fill: C.blue,
          line: { style: "solid", fill: "none", width: 0 },
        },
      ],
      scatterOptions: { style: "marker", varyColors: false },
      legend: { position: "bottom", overlay: false },
      xAxis: { numberFormatCode: "#,##0", majorGridlines: { style: "solid", fill: C.line, width: 1 } },
      yAxis: { numberFormatCode: "0%", majorGridlines: { style: "solid", fill: C.line, width: 1 } },
      chartFill: "none",
      plotAreaFill: "none",
    });
    addShape(slide, { left: 830, top: 184, width: 362, height: 424 }, C.card);
    addCardHeader(slide, 830, 184, 362, "High-coverage idle targets", "Sorted by observed-hour weighted idle share.");
    const rows = [
      ["Robot", "Observed h", "Idle %"],
      ...highCoverage.map((r) => [
        r.robot_label,
        Math.round(r.observed_hours).toString(),
        fmtPct(r.idle_share),
      ]),
    ];
    addTable(slide, rows, 3, { left: 854, top: 266, width: 314, height: 238 }, [90, 118, 86], { bodySize: 11, headerSize: 11 });
    addText(slide, "Use the scatter for prioritization: high idle percentage only matters when the robot also has enough observed hours.", {
      left: 854,
      top: 528,
      width: 314,
      height: 54,
    }, { fontSize: 13, color: C.body });
  }

  // Slide 5: data readiness and queue caveat.
  {
    const slide = setupSlide(presentation, "05");
    addSectionHeader(slide, "QUEUE READINESS", "Queue duration is not ready for KPI decisions", "The current report can support queue counts/status distribution, but not queue-time duration.");
    addShape(slide, { left: 56, top: 184, width: 742, height: 424 }, C.card);
    addCardHeader(slide, 56, 184, 742, "Queue and data readiness notes", "What is decision-ready now versus what needs a stronger source field.");
    readiness.forEach((r, i) => {
      addReadinessRow(slide, 86, 268 + i * 82, 682, r.topic, r.status, r.implication);
    });
    addInsightCard(slide, 830, 184, 362, 126, "Immediate use", "Use idle/travel duration by robot now for utilization review and prioritization.", C.teal);
    addInsightCard(slide, 830, 334, 362, 126, "Needed source fix", "Populate dequeue/completion timestamp or a trusted duration field before reporting queue-time KPIs.", C.red);
    addInsightCard(slide, 830, 484, 362, 124, "Reporting layer", "After the field is reliable, promote queue-time metrics into DWS/ADS rollups by robot, status, route, and day.", C.blue);
  }

  for (const [index, slide] of presentation.slides.items.entries()) {
    const stem = `slide-${String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")}`;
    await writeBlob(path.join(PREVIEW_DIR, `${stem}.png`), await presentation.export({ slide, format: "png", scale: 1 }));
    await fs.writeFile(path.join(LAYOUT_DIR, `${stem}.layout.json`), await (await slide.export({ format: "layout" })).text());
  }
  await writeBlob(path.join(PREVIEW_DIR, "montage.webp"), await presentation.export({ format: "webp", montage: true, scale: 1 }));
  const pptx = await PresentationFile.exportPptx(presentation);
  await pptx.save(FINAL_PPTX);
  const inspect = await presentation.inspect({ kind: "slide,textbox,shape,chart,table,layout", maxChars: 16000 });
  await fs.writeFile(path.join(SCRATCH, "inspect.ndjson"), inspect.ndjson);
  await fs.copyFile(path.join(SCRATCH, "inspect.ndjson"), `${FINAL_PPTX}.inspect.ndjson`);
  console.log(JSON.stringify({ final: FINAL_PPTX, preview: PREVIEW_DIR, layout: LAYOUT_DIR }, null, 2));
}

main().catch((error) => {
  console.error(error);
  process.exitCode = 1;
});

================================================================
BEGIN FILE: outputs/robot_idle_travel_queue_analytics.sql
================================================================
USE IOT2020;
GO

/*
    Robot idle time, travel time, queue time analytics
    Read-only script for SQL Server / DBeaver.

    Layer usage:
      - ODS is used for source coverage, freshness, and raw-table validation.
      - DWD is used for standardized metric calculation because it normalizes
        robot_code, event_time, queue duration, subjob duration, status, and speed.

    Metric definitions used here:
      1. Queue time
         Source: DWD.fact_amr_queue.
         Calculation: positive queue duration_seconds, or DATEDIFF(second, queue_start_time, queue_end_time)
         when duration_seconds is missing.

      2. Travel time
         Primary source: DWD.fact_amr_subjob.
         Calculation: positive subjob duration_seconds, or DATEDIFF(second, subjob_start_time, subjob_end_time)
         when duration_seconds is missing.
         Route-level cuts use start_station_code -> end_station_code.

      3. Idle time
         Source: DWD.fact_amr_raw_status.
         Calculation: time until the next status sample for the same robot, capped by @max_sample_gap_seconds
         so missing telemetry does not inflate idle time.
         A sample is classified as idle when either:
           - robot_status or robot_mode contains idle/wait/standby-style labels; or
           - speed_mps is below @idle_speed_threshold_mps and both job_id and subjob_id are empty.

    Important caveat:
      Queue time and travel time come from task/queue facts. Idle time comes from raw state intervals.
      They are not forced to add to 100% unless the source systems have identical event coverage.
*/

DECLARE @analysis_start DATETIME2(3) = NULL;  -- Example: '2026-06-01T00:00:00'
DECLARE @analysis_end   DATETIME2(3) = NULL;  -- Example: '2026-07-01T00:00:00'

DECLARE @max_sample_gap_seconds INT = 300;    -- Ignore raw-status gaps larger than this.
DECLARE @idle_speed_threshold_mps DECIMAL(18,6) = 0.050000;

IF @analysis_start IS NULL
BEGIN
    SELECT @analysis_start = MIN(min_time)
    FROM (
        SELECT MIN(event_time) AS min_time FROM [DWD].[fact_amr_raw_status]
        UNION ALL SELECT MIN(queue_start_time) FROM [DWD].[fact_amr_queue]
        UNION ALL SELECT MIN(subjob_start_time) FROM [DWD].[fact_amr_subjob]
    ) AS x
    WHERE min_time IS NOT NULL;
END;

IF @analysis_end IS NULL
BEGIN
    SELECT @analysis_end = MAX(max_time)
    FROM (
        SELECT MAX(event_time) AS max_time FROM [DWD].[fact_amr_raw_status]
        UNION ALL SELECT MAX(queue_end_time) FROM [DWD].[fact_amr_queue]
        UNION ALL SELECT MAX(subjob_end_time) FROM [DWD].[fact_amr_subjob]
    ) AS x
    WHERE max_time IS NOT NULL;
END;

SELECT
    @analysis_start AS analysis_start,
    @analysis_end AS analysis_end,
    @max_sample_gap_seconds AS max_sample_gap_seconds,
    @idle_speed_threshold_mps AS idle_speed_threshold_mps;

/* 1. ODS + DWD source coverage and freshness. */
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#source_coverage') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #source_coverage;

CREATE TABLE #source_coverage (
    layer_name NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    source_table NVARCHAR(256) NOT NULL,
    row_count BIGINT NULL,
    min_event_time DATETIME2(3) NULL,
    max_event_time DATETIME2(3) NULL,
    selected_time_column SYSNAME NULL,
    notes NVARCHAR(4000) NULL
);

DECLARE
    @coverage_schema SYSNAME,
    @coverage_table SYSNAME,
    @coverage_layer NVARCHAR(20),
    @coverage_time_column SYSNAME,
    @coverage_source_table NVARCHAR(256),
    @coverage_sql NVARCHAR(MAX);

DECLARE coverage_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR
SELECT layer_name, schema_name, table_name
FROM (
    VALUES
        (N'ODS', N'ODS', N'AMR_Rawdata'),
        (N'ODS', N'ODS', N'AMR_Queue'),
        (N'ODS', N'ODS', N'AMR_Subjob_Analyze'),
        (N'ODS', N'ODS', N'robot_status_history'),
        (N'ODS', N'ODS', N'robot_job_history'),
        (N'DWD', N'DWD', N'fact_amr_raw_status'),
        (N'DWD', N'DWD', N'fact_amr_queue'),
        (N'DWD', N'DWD', N'fact_amr_subjob'),
        (N'DWD', N'DWD', N'fact_robot_status'),
        (N'DWD', N'DWD', N'fact_robot_job')
) AS requested(layer_name, schema_name, table_name);

OPEN coverage_cursor;
FETCH NEXT FROM coverage_cursor INTO @coverage_layer, @coverage_schema, @coverage_table;

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
    SET @coverage_source_table = @coverage_schema + N'.' + @coverage_table;

    IF OBJECT_ID(QUOTENAME(@coverage_schema) + N'.' + QUOTENAME(@coverage_table), N'U') IS NULL
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO #source_coverage (
            layer_name, source_table, row_count, min_event_time, max_event_time, selected_time_column, notes
        )
        VALUES (
            @coverage_layer,
            QUOTENAME(@coverage_schema) + N'.' + QUOTENAME(@coverage_table),
            NULL,
            NULL,
            NULL,
            NULL,
            N'Table not found in current database.'
        );
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP (1)
            @coverage_time_column = c.name
        FROM sys.columns AS c
        WHERE c.object_id = OBJECT_ID(QUOTENAME(@coverage_schema) + N'.' + QUOTENAME(@coverage_table))
          AND c.name IN (
                N'event_time',
                N'robot_datetime',
                N'pc_timestamp',
                N'timestamp',
                N'c_timestamp',
                N'status_time',
                N'sample_time',
                N'queue_start_time',
                N'subjob_start_time',
                N'job_start_time',
                N'start_time',
                N'created_at',
                N'create_time'
          )
        ORDER BY CASE c.name
            WHEN N'event_time' THEN 1
            WHEN N'robot_datetime' THEN 2
            WHEN N'pc_timestamp' THEN 3
            WHEN N'timestamp' THEN 4
            WHEN N'c_timestamp' THEN 5
            WHEN N'status_time' THEN 6
            WHEN N'sample_time' THEN 7
            WHEN N'queue_start_time' THEN 8
            WHEN N'subjob_start_time' THEN 9
            WHEN N'job_start_time' THEN 10
            WHEN N'start_time' THEN 11
            WHEN N'created_at' THEN 12
            WHEN N'create_time' THEN 13
            ELSE 99
        END;

        IF @coverage_time_column IS NULL
        BEGIN
            SET @coverage_sql = CONCAT(N'
INSERT INTO #source_coverage (
    layer_name, source_table, row_count, min_event_time, max_event_time, selected_time_column, notes
)
SELECT
    @layer_name,
    @source_table,
    COUNT_BIG(*),
    NULL,
    NULL,
    NULL,
    N''No recognized time column found for freshness check.''
FROM ', QUOTENAME(@coverage_schema), N'.', QUOTENAME(@coverage_table), N';');
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            SET @coverage_sql = CONCAT(N'
INSERT INTO #source_coverage (
    layer_name, source_table, row_count, min_event_time, max_event_time, selected_time_column, notes
)
SELECT
    @layer_name,
    @source_table,
    COUNT_BIG(*),
    MIN(TRY_CONVERT(DATETIME2(3), ', QUOTENAME(@coverage_time_column), N')),
    MAX(TRY_CONVERT(DATETIME2(3), ', QUOTENAME(@coverage_time_column), N')),
    @selected_time_column,
    NULL
FROM ', QUOTENAME(@coverage_schema), N'.', QUOTENAME(@coverage_table), N';');
        END;

        EXEC sys.sp_executesql
            @coverage_sql,
            N'@layer_name NVARCHAR(20), @source_table NVARCHAR(256), @selected_time_column SYSNAME',
            @layer_name = @coverage_layer,
            @source_table = @coverage_source_table,
            @selected_time_column = @coverage_time_column;
    END;

    SET @coverage_time_column = NULL;
    SET @coverage_source_table = NULL;
    FETCH NEXT FROM coverage_cursor INTO @coverage_layer, @coverage_schema, @coverage_table;
END;

CLOSE coverage_cursor;
DEALLOCATE coverage_cursor;

SELECT
    layer_name,
    source_table,
    row_count,
    min_event_time,
    max_event_time,
    selected_time_column,
    notes
FROM #source_coverage
ORDER BY
    CASE layer_name WHEN N'ODS' THEN 1 WHEN N'DWD' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,
    source_table;

/* 1b. DWD lineage back to ODS rows. */
SELECT
    target_table,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS dwd_row_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN source_schema = N'ODS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_tagged_from_ods,
    SUM(CASE WHEN source_ods_row_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_with_source_ods_row_id,
    MIN(source_ods_load_time) AS min_source_ods_load_time,
    MAX(source_ods_load_time) AS max_source_ods_load_time
FROM (
    SELECT N'DWD.fact_amr_raw_status' AS target_table, source_schema, source_ods_row_id, source_ods_load_time
    FROM [DWD].[fact_amr_raw_status]
    UNION ALL
    SELECT N'DWD.fact_amr_queue', source_schema, source_ods_row_id, source_ods_load_time
    FROM [DWD].[fact_amr_queue]
    UNION ALL
    SELECT N'DWD.fact_amr_subjob', source_schema, source_ods_row_id, source_ods_load_time
    FROM [DWD].[fact_amr_subjob]
    UNION ALL
    SELECT N'DWD.fact_robot_status', source_schema, source_ods_row_id, source_ods_load_time
    FROM [DWD].[fact_robot_status]
    UNION ALL
    SELECT N'DWD.fact_robot_job', source_schema, source_ods_row_id, source_ods_load_time
    FROM [DWD].[fact_robot_job]
) AS lineage
GROUP BY target_table
ORDER BY target_table;

/* 2. Build bounded DWD metric tables. */
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#raw_intervals') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #raw_intervals;
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#idle_daily') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #idle_daily;
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#queue_events') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #queue_events;
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#queue_daily') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #queue_daily;
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#travel_events') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #travel_events;
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#travel_daily') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #travel_daily;

WITH ordered_raw AS (
    SELECT
        robot_code,
        robot_id,
        robot_name,
        CAST(event_time AS DATE) AS metric_date,
        event_time,
        LEAD(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY robot_code ORDER BY event_time) AS next_event_time,
        robot_status,
        robot_mode,
        job_id,
        subjob_id,
        speed_mps,
        online_status,
        error_code
    FROM [DWD].[fact_amr_raw_status]
    WHERE event_time >= @analysis_start
      AND event_time < @analysis_end
      AND robot_code IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    robot_code,
    robot_id,
    robot_name,
    metric_date,
    event_time,
    next_event_time,
    robot_status,
    robot_mode,
    job_id,
    subjob_id,
    speed_mps,
    online_status,
    error_code,
    DATEDIFF(SECOND, event_time, next_event_time) AS interval_seconds,
    CASE
        WHEN next_event_time IS NULL THEN 0
        WHEN DATEDIFF(SECOND, event_time, next_event_time) <= 0 THEN 0
        WHEN DATEDIFF(SECOND, event_time, next_event_time) > @max_sample_gap_seconds THEN 0
        ELSE DATEDIFF(SECOND, event_time, next_event_time)
    END AS valid_interval_seconds,
    CASE
        WHEN
            (
                   LOWER(COALESCE(robot_status, N'')) LIKE N'%idle%'
                OR LOWER(COALESCE(robot_status, N'')) LIKE N'%wait%'
                OR LOWER(COALESCE(robot_status, N'')) LIKE N'%standby%'
                OR COALESCE(robot_status, N'') LIKE N'%空闲%'
                OR COALESCE(robot_status, N'') LIKE N'%待机%'
                OR COALESCE(robot_status, N'') LIKE N'%等待%'
                OR LOWER(COALESCE(robot_mode, N'')) LIKE N'%idle%'
                OR LOWER(COALESCE(robot_mode, N'')) LIKE N'%wait%'
                OR LOWER(COALESCE(robot_mode, N'')) LIKE N'%standby%'
                OR COALESCE(robot_mode, N'') LIKE N'%空闲%'
                OR COALESCE(robot_mode, N'') LIKE N'%待机%'
                OR COALESCE(robot_mode, N'') LIKE N'%等待%'
                OR (
                    ABS(COALESCE(speed_mps, 0)) <= @idle_speed_threshold_mps
                    AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(job_id, N''))), N'') IS NULL
                    AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(subjob_id, N''))), N'') IS NULL
                )
            )
            AND LOWER(COALESCE(online_status, N'')) NOT LIKE N'%offline%'
            AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(error_code, N''))), N'') IS NULL
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS is_idle_interval,
    CASE
        WHEN ABS(COALESCE(speed_mps, 0)) > @idle_speed_threshold_mps THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS is_moving_interval
INTO #raw_intervals
FROM ordered_raw;

SELECT
    metric_date,
    robot_code,
    MAX(robot_name) AS robot_name,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS raw_sample_count,
    SUM(valid_interval_seconds) AS observed_seconds,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_idle_interval = 1 THEN valid_interval_seconds ELSE 0 END) AS idle_seconds,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_moving_interval = 1 THEN valid_interval_seconds ELSE 0 END) AS moving_seconds_from_raw_status,
    SUM(CASE WHEN interval_seconds > @max_sample_gap_seconds THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS large_gap_count,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN is_idle_interval = 1 THEN valid_interval_seconds ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
        / NULLIF(SUM(valid_interval_seconds), 0) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS idle_share_of_observed
INTO #idle_daily
FROM #raw_intervals
GROUP BY metric_date, robot_code;

SELECT
    queue_fact_id,
    queue_id,
    CAST(COALESCE(queue_start_time, event_time) AS DATE) AS metric_date,
    robot_code,
    project_code,
    job_id,
    subjob_id,
    queue_status,
    priority_value,
    start_station_code,
    end_station_code,
    queue_start_time,
    queue_end_time,
    CASE
        WHEN duration_seconds IS NOT NULL AND duration_seconds > 0 THEN duration_seconds
        WHEN queue_start_time IS NOT NULL AND queue_end_time IS NOT NULL
             AND queue_end_time > queue_start_time
            THEN DATEDIFF(SECOND, queue_start_time, queue_end_time)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS queue_seconds
INTO #queue_events
FROM [DWD].[fact_amr_queue]
WHERE COALESCE(queue_start_time, event_time) >= @analysis_start
  AND COALESCE(queue_start_time, event_time) < @analysis_end;

SELECT
    metric_date,
    robot_code,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS queue_event_count,
    SUM(queue_seconds) AS queue_seconds,
    AVG(CAST(queue_seconds AS DECIMAL(18,4))) AS avg_queue_seconds,
    MAX(queue_seconds) AS max_queue_seconds
INTO #queue_daily
FROM #queue_events
WHERE queue_seconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY metric_date, robot_code;

SELECT
    subjob_fact_id,
    subjob_id,
    job_id,
    CAST(subjob_start_time AS DATE) AS metric_date,
    robot_code,
    project_code,
    job_type_code,
    subjob_type_code,
    subjob_status,
    start_station_code,
    end_station_code,
    subjob_start_time,
    subjob_end_time,
    result_code,
    result_message,
    CASE
        WHEN duration_seconds IS NOT NULL AND duration_seconds > 0 THEN duration_seconds
        WHEN subjob_start_time IS NOT NULL AND subjob_end_time IS NOT NULL
             AND subjob_end_time > subjob_start_time
            THEN DATEDIFF(SECOND, subjob_start_time, subjob_end_time)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS travel_seconds
INTO #travel_events
FROM [DWD].[fact_amr_subjob]
WHERE subjob_start_time >= @analysis_start
  AND subjob_start_time < @analysis_end;

SELECT
    metric_date,
    robot_code,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS travel_event_count,
    SUM(travel_seconds) AS travel_seconds,
    AVG(CAST(travel_seconds AS DECIMAL(18,4))) AS avg_travel_seconds,
    MAX(travel_seconds) AS max_travel_seconds
INTO #travel_daily
FROM #travel_events
WHERE travel_seconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY metric_date, robot_code;

/* 3. Daily utilization summary. */
SELECT
    COALESCE(i.metric_date, q.metric_date, t.metric_date) AS metric_date,
    COALESCE(i.robot_code, q.robot_code, t.robot_code) AS robot_code,
    i.robot_name,
    COALESCE(i.raw_sample_count, 0) AS raw_sample_count,
    COALESCE(i.observed_seconds, 0) AS observed_seconds,
    COALESCE(i.idle_seconds, 0) AS idle_seconds,
    COALESCE(t.travel_seconds, 0) AS travel_seconds,
    COALESCE(q.queue_seconds, 0) AS queue_seconds,
    COALESCE(i.moving_seconds_from_raw_status, 0) AS moving_seconds_from_raw_status,
    COALESCE(t.travel_event_count, 0) AS travel_event_count,
    COALESCE(q.queue_event_count, 0) AS queue_event_count,
    CAST(COALESCE(i.idle_seconds, 0) / 3600.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS idle_hours,
    CAST(COALESCE(t.travel_seconds, 0) / 3600.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS travel_hours,
    CAST(COALESCE(q.queue_seconds, 0) / 3600.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS queue_hours,
    CAST(COALESCE(i.idle_seconds, 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(i.observed_seconds, 0) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS idle_share_of_observed,
    CAST(COALESCE(t.travel_seconds, 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(i.observed_seconds, 0) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS travel_share_of_observed,
    CAST(COALESCE(q.queue_seconds, 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(i.observed_seconds, 0) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS queue_share_of_observed,
    COALESCE(i.large_gap_count, 0) AS raw_status_large_gap_count
FROM #idle_daily AS i
FULL OUTER JOIN #queue_daily AS q
    ON q.metric_date = i.metric_date
   AND q.robot_code = i.robot_code
FULL OUTER JOIN #travel_daily AS t
    ON t.metric_date = COALESCE(i.metric_date, q.metric_date)
   AND t.robot_code = COALESCE(i.robot_code, q.robot_code)
ORDER BY metric_date, robot_code;

/* 4. Robot-level summary for the selected window. */
SELECT
    robot_code,
    MAX(robot_name) AS robot_name,
    MIN(metric_date) AS first_metric_date,
    MAX(metric_date) AS last_metric_date,
    SUM(raw_sample_count) AS raw_sample_count,
    SUM(observed_seconds) AS observed_seconds,
    SUM(idle_seconds) AS idle_seconds,
    CAST(SUM(idle_seconds) / 3600.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS idle_hours,
    CAST(SUM(idle_seconds) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(observed_seconds), 0) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS idle_share_of_observed,
    SUM(moving_seconds_from_raw_status) AS moving_seconds_from_raw_status,
    CAST(SUM(moving_seconds_from_raw_status) / 3600.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS moving_hours_from_raw_status,
    SUM(large_gap_count) AS raw_status_large_gap_count
FROM #idle_daily
GROUP BY robot_code
ORDER BY idle_seconds DESC;

/* 5. Queue by robot, status, and station pair. */
SELECT
    robot_code,
    queue_status,
    start_station_code,
    end_station_code,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS queue_event_count,
    SUM(queue_seconds) AS queue_seconds,
    CAST(SUM(queue_seconds) / 3600.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS queue_hours,
    AVG(CAST(queue_seconds AS DECIMAL(18,4))) AS avg_queue_seconds,
    MAX(queue_seconds) AS max_queue_seconds
FROM #queue_events
WHERE queue_seconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    robot_code,
    queue_status,
    start_station_code,
    end_station_code
ORDER BY queue_seconds DESC;

/* 6. Travel by robot, subjob type, and station pair. */
SELECT
    robot_code,
    project_code,
    job_type_code,
    subjob_type_code,
    subjob_status,
    start_station_code,
    end_station_code,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS travel_event_count,
    SUM(travel_seconds) AS travel_seconds,
    CAST(SUM(travel_seconds) / 3600.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS travel_hours,
    AVG(CAST(travel_seconds AS DECIMAL(18,4))) AS avg_travel_seconds,
    MAX(travel_seconds) AS max_travel_seconds
FROM #travel_events
WHERE travel_seconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    robot_code,
    project_code,
    job_type_code,
    subjob_type_code,
    subjob_status,
    start_station_code,
    end_station_code
ORDER BY travel_seconds DESC;

/* 7. Raw status mix for validating the idle classifier. */
SELECT
    robot_status,
    robot_mode,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS sample_count,
    SUM(valid_interval_seconds) AS observed_seconds,
    CAST(SUM(valid_interval_seconds) / 3600.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS observed_hours,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_idle_interval = 1 THEN valid_interval_seconds ELSE 0 END) AS classified_idle_seconds,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN is_idle_interval = 1 THEN valid_interval_seconds ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
        / NULLIF(SUM(valid_interval_seconds), 0) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS classified_idle_share
FROM #raw_intervals
GROUP BY robot_status, robot_mode
ORDER BY observed_seconds DESC;

/* 8. Data quality checks that can change interpretation. */
SELECT
    N'raw_status_rows_with_null_event_time' AS check_name,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS issue_count
FROM [DWD].[fact_amr_raw_status]
WHERE event_time IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT
    N'raw_status_large_gaps_over_threshold',
    COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM #raw_intervals
WHERE interval_seconds > @max_sample_gap_seconds
UNION ALL
SELECT
    N'queue_events_without_positive_duration',
    COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM #queue_events
WHERE queue_seconds IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT
    N'travel_events_without_positive_duration',
    COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM #travel_events
WHERE travel_seconds IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT
    N'queue_events_without_robot_code',
    COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM #queue_events
WHERE robot_code IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT
    N'travel_events_without_robot_code',
    COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM #travel_events
WHERE robot_code IS NULL;

================================================================
END FILE: outputs/robot_idle_travel_queue_analytics.sql

- Those preview modes may disable JavaScript, so charts, hover tooltips, filters, sorting, and animations may not run.
- The HTML is self-contained. It already includes the data, CSS, and JavaScript, so no database connection is required.

Interactive features:
- KPI cards and chart entry animation.
- Hover chart bars and scatter points for detail tooltips.
- Click robot bars or scatter points to focus the robot detail table.
- Search, filter, and sort the robot utilization table.

================================================================
END FILE: outputs/robot_idle_travel_queue_interactive_report_README.txt

================================================================
BEGIN FILE: outputs/robot_idle_travel_queue_rollup.sql
================================================================
USE IOT2020;
GO

/*
    Robot idle / travel / queue rollup.
    Read-only against business tables. Uses temporary tables only in the current SQL session.

    ODS role: source coverage and freshness.
    DWD role: standardized idle, travel, and queue metric calculation.
*/

DECLARE @analysis_start DATETIME2(3) = NULL;
DECLARE @analysis_end   DATETIME2(3) = NULL;
DECLARE @max_sample_gap_seconds INT = 300;
DECLARE @idle_speed_threshold_mps DECIMAL(18,6) = 0.050000;

IF @analysis_start IS NULL
BEGIN
    SELECT @analysis_start = MIN(min_time)
    FROM (
        SELECT MIN(event_time) AS min_time FROM [DWD].[fact_amr_raw_status]
        UNION ALL SELECT MIN(queue_start_time) FROM [DWD].[fact_amr_queue]
        UNION ALL SELECT MIN(subjob_start_time) FROM [DWD].[fact_amr_subjob]
    ) AS x
    WHERE min_time IS NOT NULL;
END;

IF @analysis_end IS NULL
BEGIN
    SELECT @analysis_end = MAX(max_time)
    FROM (
        SELECT MAX(event_time) AS max_time FROM [DWD].[fact_amr_raw_status]
        UNION ALL SELECT MAX(queue_end_time) FROM [DWD].[fact_amr_queue]
        UNION ALL SELECT MAX(subjob_end_time) FROM [DWD].[fact_amr_subjob]
    ) AS x
    WHERE max_time IS NOT NULL;
END;

IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#rollup') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #rollup;
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#raw_intervals') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #raw_intervals;
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#queue_events') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #queue_events;
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#travel_events') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #travel_events;

CREATE TABLE #rollup (
    section_name NVARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
    metric_name NVARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
    layer_name NVARCHAR(20) NULL,
    source_table NVARCHAR(256) NULL,
    robot_code NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
    dimension_1 NVARCHAR(256) NULL,
    dimension_2 NVARCHAR(256) NULL,
    count_value BIGINT NULL,
    seconds_value BIGINT NULL,
    hours_value DECIMAL(18,2) NULL,
    rate_value DECIMAL(18,4) NULL,
    min_time DATETIME2(3) NULL,
    max_time DATETIME2(3) NULL,
    notes NVARCHAR(1000) NULL
);

INSERT INTO #rollup (
    section_name, metric_name, min_time, max_time, count_value, notes
)
VALUES (
    N'PARAMETER',
    N'analysis_window',
    @analysis_start,
    @analysis_end,
    @max_sample_gap_seconds,
    CONCAT(N'idle_speed_threshold_mps=', CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @idle_speed_threshold_mps))
);

/* ODS coverage. */
DECLARE
    @schema_name SYSNAME,
    @table_name SYSNAME,
    @time_column SYSNAME,
    @source_table_label NVARCHAR(256),
    @sql NVARCHAR(MAX);

DECLARE ods_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR
SELECT schema_name, table_name
FROM (
    VALUES
        (N'ODS', N'AMR_Rawdata'),
        (N'ODS', N'AMR_Queue'),
        (N'ODS', N'AMR_Subjob_Analyze'),
        (N'ODS', N'robot_status_history'),
        (N'ODS', N'robot_job_history')
) AS t(schema_name, table_name);

OPEN ods_cursor;
FETCH NEXT FROM ods_cursor INTO @schema_name, @table_name;

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
    SET @source_table_label = @schema_name + N'.' + @table_name;

    IF OBJECT_ID(QUOTENAME(@schema_name) + N'.' + QUOTENAME(@table_name), N'U') IS NULL
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO #rollup (
            section_name, metric_name, layer_name, source_table, notes
        )
        VALUES (
            N'SOURCE_COVERAGE',
            N'ods_table_missing',
            N'ODS',
            @schema_name + N'.' + @table_name,
            N'Table not found.'
        );
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP (1)
            @time_column = c.name
        FROM sys.columns AS c
        WHERE c.object_id = OBJECT_ID(QUOTENAME(@schema_name) + N'.' + QUOTENAME(@table_name))
          AND c.name IN (
                N'event_time', N'robot_datetime', N'pc_timestamp', N'timestamp', N'c_timestamp',
                N'status_time', N'sample_time', N'queue_start_time', N'subjob_start_time',
                N'job_start_time', N'start_time', N'created_at', N'create_time'
          )
        ORDER BY CASE c.name
            WHEN N'event_time' THEN 1
            WHEN N'robot_datetime' THEN 2
            WHEN N'pc_timestamp' THEN 3
            WHEN N'timestamp' THEN 4
            WHEN N'c_timestamp' THEN 5
            WHEN N'status_time' THEN 6
            WHEN N'sample_time' THEN 7
            WHEN N'queue_start_time' THEN 8
            WHEN N'subjob_start_time' THEN 9
            WHEN N'job_start_time' THEN 10
            WHEN N'start_time' THEN 11
            WHEN N'created_at' THEN 12
            WHEN N'create_time' THEN 13
            ELSE 99
        END;

        IF @time_column IS NULL
        BEGIN
            SET @sql = CONCAT(N'
INSERT INTO #rollup (
    section_name, metric_name, layer_name, source_table, count_value, notes
)
SELECT
    N''SOURCE_COVERAGE'',
    N''ods_row_count'',
    N''ODS'',
    @source_table,
    COUNT_BIG(*),
    N''No recognized time column.''
FROM ', QUOTENAME(@schema_name), N'.', QUOTENAME(@table_name), N';');
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            SET @sql = CONCAT(N'
INSERT INTO #rollup (
    section_name, metric_name, layer_name, source_table, count_value, min_time, max_time, notes
)
SELECT
    N''SOURCE_COVERAGE'',
    N''ods_row_count_and_freshness'',
    N''ODS'',
    @source_table,
    COUNT_BIG(*),
    MIN(TRY_CONVERT(DATETIME2(3), ', QUOTENAME(@time_column), N')),
    MAX(TRY_CONVERT(DATETIME2(3), ', QUOTENAME(@time_column), N')),
    CONCAT(N''time_column='', @time_column)
FROM ', QUOTENAME(@schema_name), N'.', QUOTENAME(@table_name), N';');
        END;

        EXEC sys.sp_executesql
            @sql,
            N'@source_table NVARCHAR(256), @time_column SYSNAME',
            @source_table = @source_table_label,
            @time_column = @time_column;
    END;

    SET @time_column = NULL;
    SET @source_table_label = NULL;
    FETCH NEXT FROM ods_cursor INTO @schema_name, @table_name;
END;

CLOSE ods_cursor;
DEALLOCATE ods_cursor;

/* DWD coverage. */
INSERT INTO #rollup (
    section_name, metric_name, layer_name, source_table, count_value, min_time, max_time
)
SELECT N'SOURCE_COVERAGE', N'dwd_row_count_and_freshness', N'DWD', N'DWD.fact_amr_raw_status',
       COUNT_BIG(*), MIN(event_time), MAX(event_time)
FROM [DWD].[fact_amr_raw_status]
UNION ALL
SELECT N'SOURCE_COVERAGE', N'dwd_row_count_and_freshness', N'DWD', N'DWD.fact_amr_queue',
       COUNT_BIG(*), MIN(COALESCE(queue_start_time, event_time)), MAX(COALESCE(queue_end_time, event_time))
FROM [DWD].[fact_amr_queue]
UNION ALL
SELECT N'SOURCE_COVERAGE', N'dwd_row_count_and_freshness', N'DWD', N'DWD.fact_amr_subjob',
       COUNT_BIG(*), MIN(subjob_start_time), MAX(subjob_end_time)
FROM [DWD].[fact_amr_subjob];

WITH ordered_raw AS (
    SELECT
        robot_code,
        robot_id,
        robot_name,
        event_time,
        LEAD(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY robot_code ORDER BY event_time) AS next_event_time,
        robot_status,
        robot_mode,
        job_id,
        subjob_id,
        speed_mps,
        online_status,
        error_code
    FROM [DWD].[fact_amr_raw_status]
    WHERE event_time >= @analysis_start
      AND event_time < @analysis_end
      AND robot_code IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    robot_code,
    robot_name,
    event_time,
    next_event_time,
    robot_status,
    robot_mode,
    job_id,
    subjob_id,
    speed_mps,
    online_status,
    error_code,
    DATEDIFF(SECOND, event_time, next_event_time) AS interval_seconds,
    CASE
        WHEN next_event_time IS NULL THEN 0
        WHEN DATEDIFF(SECOND, event_time, next_event_time) <= 0 THEN 0
        WHEN DATEDIFF(SECOND, event_time, next_event_time) > @max_sample_gap_seconds THEN 0
        ELSE DATEDIFF(SECOND, event_time, next_event_time)
    END AS valid_interval_seconds,
    CASE
        WHEN
            (
                   LOWER(COALESCE(robot_status, N'')) LIKE N'%idle%'
                OR LOWER(COALESCE(robot_status, N'')) LIKE N'%wait%'
                OR LOWER(COALESCE(robot_status, N'')) LIKE N'%standby%'
                OR COALESCE(robot_status, N'') LIKE N'%空闲%'
                OR COALESCE(robot_status, N'') LIKE N'%待机%'
                OR COALESCE(robot_status, N'') LIKE N'%等待%'
                OR LOWER(COALESCE(robot_mode, N'')) LIKE N'%idle%'
                OR LOWER(COALESCE(robot_mode, N'')) LIKE N'%wait%'
                OR LOWER(COALESCE(robot_mode, N'')) LIKE N'%standby%'
                OR COALESCE(robot_mode, N'') LIKE N'%空闲%'
                OR COALESCE(robot_mode, N'') LIKE N'%待机%'
                OR COALESCE(robot_mode, N'') LIKE N'%等待%'
                OR (
                    ABS(COALESCE(speed_mps, 0)) <= @idle_speed_threshold_mps
                    AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(job_id, N''))), N'') IS NULL
                    AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(subjob_id, N''))), N'') IS NULL
                )
            )
            AND LOWER(COALESCE(online_status, N'')) NOT LIKE N'%offline%'
            AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(error_code, N''))), N'') IS NULL
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS is_idle_interval
INTO #raw_intervals
FROM ordered_raw;

SELECT
    queue_fact_id,
    queue_id,
    robot_code,
    queue_status,
    start_station_code,
    end_station_code,
    CASE
        WHEN duration_seconds IS NOT NULL AND duration_seconds > 0 THEN duration_seconds
        WHEN queue_start_time IS NOT NULL AND queue_end_time IS NOT NULL
             AND queue_end_time > queue_start_time
            THEN DATEDIFF(SECOND, queue_start_time, queue_end_time)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS queue_seconds
INTO #queue_events
FROM [DWD].[fact_amr_queue]
WHERE COALESCE(queue_start_time, event_time) >= @analysis_start
  AND COALESCE(queue_start_time, event_time) < @analysis_end;

SELECT
    subjob_fact_id,
    subjob_id,
    job_id,
    robot_code,
    project_code,
    job_type_code,
    subjob_type_code,
    subjob_status,
    start_station_code,
    end_station_code,
    CASE
        WHEN duration_seconds IS NOT NULL AND duration_seconds > 0 THEN duration_seconds
        WHEN subjob_start_time IS NOT NULL AND subjob_end_time IS NOT NULL
             AND subjob_end_time > subjob_start_time
            THEN DATEDIFF(SECOND, subjob_start_time, subjob_end_time)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS travel_seconds
INTO #travel_events
FROM [DWD].[fact_amr_subjob]
WHERE subjob_start_time >= @analysis_start
  AND subjob_start_time < @analysis_end;

/* Overall metric totals. */
INSERT INTO #rollup (
    section_name, metric_name, layer_name, source_table, count_value, seconds_value, hours_value, rate_value
)
SELECT
    N'OVERALL_METRIC',
    N'idle_time',
    N'DWD',
    N'DWD.fact_amr_raw_status',
    COUNT_BIG(*),
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_idle_interval = 1 THEN valid_interval_seconds ELSE 0 END),
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN is_idle_interval = 1 THEN valid_interval_seconds ELSE 0 END) / 3600.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)),
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN is_idle_interval = 1 THEN valid_interval_seconds ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
        / NULLIF(SUM(valid_interval_seconds), 0) AS DECIMAL(18,4))
FROM #raw_intervals
UNION ALL
SELECT
    N'OVERALL_METRIC',
    N'travel_time',
    N'DWD',
    N'DWD.fact_amr_subjob',
    COUNT_BIG(*),
    SUM(travel_seconds),
    CAST(SUM(travel_seconds) / 3600.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)),
    NULL
FROM #travel_events
WHERE travel_seconds IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT
    N'OVERALL_METRIC',
    N'queue_time',
    N'DWD',
    N'DWD.fact_amr_queue',
    COUNT_BIG(*),
    SUM(queue_seconds),
    CAST(SUM(queue_seconds) / 3600.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)),
    NULL
FROM #queue_events
WHERE queue_seconds IS NOT NULL;

/* Top robots by each time metric. */
INSERT INTO #rollup (
    section_name, metric_name, layer_name, source_table, robot_code, dimension_1,
    count_value, seconds_value, hours_value, rate_value
)
SELECT TOP (10)
    N'TOP_ROBOT',
    N'idle_time',
    N'DWD',
    N'DWD.fact_amr_raw_status',
    robot_code,
    MAX(robot_name),
    COUNT_BIG(*),
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_idle_interval = 1 THEN valid_interval_seconds ELSE 0 END),
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN is_idle_interval = 1 THEN valid_interval_seconds ELSE 0 END) / 3600.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)),
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN is_idle_interval = 1 THEN valid_interval_seconds ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
        / NULLIF(SUM(valid_interval_seconds), 0) AS DECIMAL(18,4))
FROM #raw_intervals
GROUP BY robot_code
ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN is_idle_interval = 1 THEN valid_interval_seconds ELSE 0 END) DESC;

INSERT INTO #rollup (
    section_name, metric_name, layer_name, source_table, robot_code,
    count_value, seconds_value, hours_value
)
SELECT TOP (10)
    N'TOP_ROBOT',
    N'travel_time',
    N'DWD',
    N'DWD.fact_amr_subjob',
    robot_code,
    COUNT_BIG(*),
    SUM(travel_seconds),
    CAST(SUM(travel_seconds) / 3600.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
FROM #travel_events
WHERE travel_seconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY robot_code
ORDER BY SUM(travel_seconds) DESC;

INSERT INTO #rollup (
    section_name, metric_name, layer_name, source_table, robot_code,
    count_value, seconds_value, hours_value
)
SELECT TOP (10)
    N'TOP_ROBOT',
    N'queue_time',
    N'DWD',
    N'DWD.fact_amr_queue',
    robot_code,
    COUNT_BIG(*),
    SUM(queue_seconds),
    CAST(SUM(queue_seconds) / 3600.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
FROM #queue_events
WHERE queue_seconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY robot_code
ORDER BY SUM(queue_seconds) DESC;

/* Top route/status combinations. */
INSERT INTO #rollup (
    section_name, metric_name, layer_name, source_table, robot_code, dimension_1, dimension_2,
    count_value, seconds_value, hours_value
)
SELECT TOP (10)
    N'TOP_ROUTE',
    N'travel_time',
    N'DWD',
    N'DWD.fact_amr_subjob',
    robot_code,
    CONCAT(COALESCE(start_station_code, N'(unknown)'), N' -> ', COALESCE(end_station_code, N'(unknown)')),
    CONCAT(COALESCE(job_type_code, N'(unknown)'), N' / ', COALESCE(subjob_type_code, N'(unknown)'), N' / ', COALESCE(subjob_status, N'(unknown)')),
    COUNT_BIG(*),
    SUM(travel_seconds),
    CAST(SUM(travel_seconds) / 3600.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
FROM #travel_events
WHERE travel_seconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    robot_code,
    start_station_code,
    end_station_code,
    job_type_code,
    subjob_type_code,
    subjob_status
ORDER BY SUM(travel_seconds) DESC;

INSERT INTO #rollup (
    section_name, metric_name, layer_name, source_table, robot_code, dimension_1, dimension_2,
    count_value, seconds_value, hours_value
)
SELECT TOP (10)
    N'TOP_ROUTE',
    N'queue_time',
    N'DWD',
    N'DWD.fact_amr_queue',
    robot_code,
    CONCAT(COALESCE(start_station_code, N'(unknown)'), N' -> ', COALESCE(end_station_code, N'(unknown)')),
    COALESCE(queue_status, N'(unknown)'),
    COUNT_BIG(*),
    SUM(queue_seconds),
    CAST(SUM(queue_seconds) / 3600.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
FROM #queue_events
WHERE queue_seconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    robot_code,
    start_station_code,
    end_station_code,
    queue_status
ORDER BY SUM(queue_seconds) DESC;

/* Data quality checks. */
INSERT INTO #rollup (
    section_name, metric_name, layer_name, source_table, count_value, notes
)
SELECT N'DATA_QUALITY', N'raw_status_large_gaps_over_threshold', N'DWD', N'DWD.fact_amr_raw_status',
       COUNT_BIG(*), CONCAT(N'threshold_seconds=', @max_sample_gap_seconds)
FROM #raw_intervals
WHERE interval_seconds > @max_sample_gap_seconds
UNION ALL
SELECT N'DATA_QUALITY', N'queue_events_without_positive_duration', N'DWD', N'DWD.fact_amr_queue',
       COUNT_BIG(*), NULL
FROM #queue_events
WHERE queue_seconds IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT N'DATA_QUALITY', N'travel_events_without_positive_duration', N'DWD', N'DWD.fact_amr_subjob',
       COUNT_BIG(*), NULL
FROM #travel_events
WHERE travel_seconds IS NULL;

SELECT
    section_name,
    metric_name,
    layer_name,
    source_table,
    robot_code,
    dimension_1,
    dimension_2,
    count_value,
    seconds_value,
    hours_value,
    rate_value,
    min_time,
    max_time,
    notes
FROM #rollup
ORDER BY
    CASE section_name
        WHEN N'PARAMETER' THEN 1
        WHEN N'SOURCE_COVERAGE' THEN 2
        WHEN N'OVERALL_METRIC' THEN 3
        WHEN N'TOP_ROBOT' THEN 4
        WHEN N'TOP_ROUTE' THEN 5
        WHEN N'DATA_QUALITY' THEN 6
        ELSE 99
    END,
    metric_name,
    seconds_value DESC,
    count_value DESC,
    source_table,
    robot_code;

================================================================
END FILE: outputs/robot_idle_travel_queue_rollup.sql
================================================================

================================================================
BEGIN FILE: outputs/robot_idle_travel_queue_source_diagnostics.sql
================================================================
USE IOT2020;
GO

/*
    Lightweight read-only diagnostics for idle / travel / queue analytics.

    Purpose:
      Find why the rollup returned zero metrics:
        - DWD fact tables have rows but no usable min/max time window.
        - DWD.fact_amr_raw_status is empty.
        - ODS queue/subjob tables exist but the previous script did not recognize
          their actual time column names.

    This script reads metadata and bounded TOP samples only.
    It does not create, update, or delete business data.
*/

/* 1. Candidate columns in ODS and DWD tables. */
SELECT
    s.name AS schema_name,
    t.name AS table_name,
    c.column_id,
    c.name AS column_name,
    ty.name AS data_type,
    c.max_length,
    c.precision,
    c.scale,
    c.is_nullable
FROM sys.tables AS t
JOIN sys.schemas AS s
    ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id
JOIN sys.columns AS c
    ON c.object_id = t.object_id
JOIN sys.types AS ty
    ON ty.user_type_id = c.user_type_id
WHERE
    (
           (s.name = N'ODS' AND t.name IN (
                N'AMR_Queue',
                N'AMR_Subjob_Analyze',
                N'AMR_Rawdata',
                N'robot_status_history',
                N'robot_job_history'
           ))
        OR (s.name = N'DWD' AND t.name IN (
                N'fact_amr_queue',
                N'fact_amr_subjob',
                N'fact_amr_raw_status',
                N'fact_robot_status',
                N'fact_robot_job'
           ))
    )
    AND (
           LOWER(c.name) LIKE N'%time%'
        OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE N'%date%'
        OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE N'%duration%'
        OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE N'%second%'
        OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE N'%start%'
        OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE N'%end%'
        OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE N'%status%'
        OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE N'%state%'
        OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE N'%speed%'
        OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE N'%robot%'
        OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE N'%amr%'
        OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE N'%queue%'
        OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE N'%job%'
        OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE N'%station%'
        OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE N'%position%'
    )
ORDER BY
    s.name,
    t.name,
    c.column_id;

/* 2. DWD normalized field null coverage. */
SELECT
    N'DWD.fact_amr_queue' AS table_name,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS row_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN event_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS event_time_non_null,
    SUM(CASE WHEN queue_start_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS start_time_non_null,
    SUM(CASE WHEN queue_end_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS end_time_non_null,
    SUM(CASE WHEN duration_seconds IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS duration_non_null,
    MIN(COALESCE(queue_start_time, event_time)) AS min_time,
    MAX(COALESCE(queue_end_time, event_time)) AS max_time
FROM [DWD].[fact_amr_queue]
UNION ALL
SELECT
    N'DWD.fact_amr_subjob',
    COUNT_BIG(*),
    NULL,
    SUM(CASE WHEN subjob_start_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    SUM(CASE WHEN subjob_end_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    SUM(CASE WHEN duration_seconds IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    MIN(subjob_start_time),
    MAX(subjob_end_time)
FROM [DWD].[fact_amr_subjob]
UNION ALL
SELECT
    N'DWD.fact_amr_raw_status',
    COUNT_BIG(*),
    SUM(CASE WHEN event_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    NULL,
    NULL,
    NULL,
    MIN(event_time),
    MAX(event_time)
FROM [DWD].[fact_amr_raw_status];

/* 3. Bounded samples from DWD facts. */
SELECT TOP (20)
    N'DWD.fact_amr_queue' AS sample_table,
    queue_fact_id,
    queue_id,
    event_time,
    robot_code,
    project_code,
    job_id,
    subjob_id,
    queue_status,
    start_station_code,
    end_station_code,
    queue_start_time,
    queue_end_time,
    duration_seconds,
    source_ods_row_id,
    source_ods_load_time
FROM [DWD].[fact_amr_queue]
ORDER BY queue_fact_id DESC;

SELECT TOP (20)
    N'DWD.fact_amr_subjob' AS sample_table,
    subjob_fact_id,
    subjob_id,
    job_id,
    robot_code,
    project_code,
    job_type_code,
    subjob_type_code,
    subjob_status,
    start_station_code,
    end_station_code,
    subjob_start_time,
    subjob_end_time,
    duration_seconds,
    source_ods_row_id,
    source_ods_load_time
FROM [DWD].[fact_amr_subjob]
ORDER BY subjob_fact_id DESC;

/* 4. ODS row-count only for source tables. */
SELECT
    N'ODS.AMR_Queue' AS table_name,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS row_count
FROM [ODS].[AMR_Queue]
UNION ALL
SELECT
    N'ODS.AMR_Subjob_Analyze',
    COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM [ODS].[AMR_Subjob_Analyze]
UNION ALL
SELECT
    N'ODS.robot_status_history',
    COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM [ODS].[robot_status_history]
UNION ALL
SELECT
    N'ODS.robot_job_history',
    COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM [ODS].[robot_job_history];


================================================================
END FILE: outputs/robot_idle_travel_queue_source_diagnostics.sql

BEGIN FILE: outputs/robot_ods_build_global_temp_intervals.sql
================================================================
USE IOT2020;

/*
    Build full-history robot status intervals into a global temp table.
    Read-only against business tables. Writes only to tempdb global temp table:
      ##robot_status_intervals_full

    Keep the DataGrip session open after running this script; the export script
    can then read the global temp table quickly.
*/

DECLARE @analysis_start DATETIME2(3) = NULL;
DECLARE @analysis_end DATETIME2(3) = NULL;
DECLARE @max_sample_gap_seconds INT = 300;
DECLARE @idle_speed_threshold DECIMAL(10,3) = 0.050;

IF @analysis_start IS NULL
BEGIN
    SELECT @analysis_start = MIN(robot_datetime)
    FROM [ODS].[robot_status_history]
    WHERE robot_datetime IS NOT NULL;
END;

IF @analysis_end IS NULL
BEGIN
    SELECT @analysis_end = MAX(robot_datetime)
    FROM [ODS].[robot_status_history]
    WHERE robot_datetime IS NOT NULL;
END;

IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..##robot_status_intervals_full') IS NOT NULL
    DROP TABLE ##robot_status_intervals_full;

WITH ordered_status AS (
    SELECT
        amr_id,
        CAST(robot_datetime AS DATE) AS metric_date,
        robot_datetime,
        pc_timestamp,
        robot_speed,
        LEAD(robot_datetime) OVER (
            PARTITION BY amr_id
            ORDER BY robot_datetime, pc_timestamp
        ) AS next_robot_datetime
    FROM [ODS].[robot_status_history]
    WHERE robot_datetime >= @analysis_start
      AND robot_datetime < @analysis_end
      AND amr_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    amr_id,
    metric_date,
    @analysis_start AS analysis_start,
    @analysis_end AS analysis_end,
    DATEDIFF(SECOND, robot_datetime, next_robot_datetime) AS interval_seconds,
    CASE
        WHEN next_robot_datetime IS NULL THEN 0
        WHEN DATEDIFF(SECOND, robot_datetime, next_robot_datetime) <= 0 THEN 0
        WHEN DATEDIFF(SECOND, robot_datetime, next_robot_datetime) > @max_sample_gap_seconds THEN 0
        ELSE DATEDIFF(SECOND, robot_datetime, next_robot_datetime)
    END AS valid_interval_seconds,
    CASE
        WHEN ABS(COALESCE(robot_speed, 0)) <= @idle_speed_threshold THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS is_idle,
    CASE
        WHEN ABS(COALESCE(robot_speed, 0)) > @idle_speed_threshold THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS is_moving,
    @max_sample_gap_seconds AS max_sample_gap_seconds
INTO ##robot_status_intervals_full
FROM ordered_status;

CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_robot_status_intervals_full_date_robot
ON ##robot_status_intervals_full(metric_date, amr_id);

CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_robot_status_intervals_full_robot
ON ##robot_status_intervals_full(amr_id);

SELECT
    MIN(analysis_start) AS analysis_start,
    MAX(analysis_end) AS analysis_end,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS interval_row_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT amr_id) AS robot_count,
    MIN(metric_date) AS min_metric_date,
    MAX(metric_date) AS max_metric_date
FROM ##robot_status_intervals_full;

================================================================
END FILE: outputs/robot_ods_build_global_temp_intervals.sql
================================================================

BEGIN FILE: outputs/robot_ods_build_tempdb_intervals.sql
================================================================
USE IOT2020;

/*
    Build full-history robot status intervals into tempdb.
    Read-only against business tables. Writes only to:
      tempdb.dbo.robot_status_intervals_full_codex

    This table is for analysis/export only and can be dropped after use.
*/

DECLARE @analysis_start DATETIME2(3) = NULL;
DECLARE @analysis_end DATETIME2(3) = NULL;
DECLARE @max_sample_gap_seconds INT = 300;
DECLARE @idle_speed_threshold DECIMAL(10,3) = 0.050;

IF @analysis_start IS NULL
BEGIN
    SELECT @analysis_start = MIN(robot_datetime)
    FROM [ODS].[robot_status_history]
    WHERE robot_datetime IS NOT NULL;
END;

IF @analysis_end IS NULL
BEGIN
    SELECT @analysis_end = MAX(robot_datetime)
    FROM [ODS].[robot_status_history]
    WHERE robot_datetime IS NOT NULL;
END;

IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb.dbo.robot_status_intervals_full_codex') IS NOT NULL
    DROP TABLE tempdb.dbo.robot_status_intervals_full_codex;

WITH ordered_status AS (
    SELECT
        amr_id,
        CAST(robot_datetime AS DATE) AS metric_date,
        robot_datetime,
        pc_timestamp,
        robot_speed,
        LEAD(robot_datetime) OVER (
            PARTITION BY amr_id
            ORDER BY robot_datetime, pc_timestamp
        ) AS next_robot_datetime
    FROM [ODS].[robot_status_history]
    WHERE robot_datetime >= @analysis_start
      AND robot_datetime < @analysis_end
      AND amr_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    amr_id,
    metric_date,
    @analysis_start AS analysis_start,
    @analysis_end AS analysis_end,
    DATEDIFF(SECOND, robot_datetime, next_robot_datetime) AS interval_seconds,
    CASE
        WHEN next_robot_datetime IS NULL THEN 0
        WHEN DATEDIFF(SECOND, robot_datetime, next_robot_datetime) <= 0 THEN 0
        WHEN DATEDIFF(SECOND, robot_datetime, next_robot_datetime) > @max_sample_gap_seconds THEN 0
        ELSE DATEDIFF(SECOND, robot_datetime, next_robot_datetime)
    END AS valid_interval_seconds,
    CASE
        WHEN ABS(COALESCE(robot_speed, 0)) <= @idle_speed_threshold THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS is_idle,
    CASE
        WHEN ABS(COALESCE(robot_speed, 0)) > @idle_speed_threshold THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS is_moving,
    @max_sample_gap_seconds AS max_sample_gap_seconds
INTO tempdb.dbo.robot_status_intervals_full_codex
FROM ordered_status;

CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_robot_status_intervals_full_codex_date_robot
ON tempdb.dbo.robot_status_intervals_full_codex(metric_date, amr_id);

CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_robot_status_intervals_full_codex_robot

    MIN(analysis_start) AS analysis_start,
    MAX(analysis_end) AS analysis_end,

    MIN(metric_date) AS min_metric_date,
    MAX(metric_date) AS max_metric_date
FROM tempdb.dbo.robot_status_intervals_full_codex;

================================================================
END FILE: outputs/robot_ods_build_tempdb_intervals.sql

BEGIN FILE: outputs/robot_ods_export_from_global_temp.sql
================================================================
USE IOT2020;

/*
    Export idle / travel / queue analytics from ##robot_status_intervals_full.
    Run robot_ods_build_global_temp_intervals.sql first in DataGrip and keep the
    DataGrip session open.
*/

WITH status_agg AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN GROUPING(metric_date) = 1 AND GROUPING(amr_id) = 1 THEN 'overall'
            WHEN GROUPING(metric_date) = 1 THEN 'robot_total'
            ELSE 'robot_daily'
        END AS result_type,
        CASE
            WHEN GROUPING(metric_date) = 1 THEN CAST(NULL AS DATE)
            ELSE metric_date
        END AS metric_date,
        CASE
            WHEN GROUPING(amr_id) = 1 THEN CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(100))
            ELSE CAST(amr_id AS NVARCHAR(100))
        END AS amr_id,
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(100)) AS queue_status,
        MIN(analysis_start) AS analysis_start,
        MAX(analysis_end) AS analysis_end,
        COUNT_BIG(*) AS status_sample_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT amr_id) AS robot_count,
        SUM(valid_interval_seconds) AS observed_seconds,
        CAST(SUM(valid_interval_seconds) / 3600.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS observed_hours,
        SUM(CASE WHEN is_idle = 1 THEN valid_interval_seconds ELSE 0 END) AS idle_seconds,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN is_idle = 1 THEN valid_interval_seconds ELSE 0 END) / 3600.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS idle_hours,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN is_idle = 1 THEN valid_interval_seconds ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
            / NULLIF(SUM(valid_interval_seconds), 0) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS idle_share,
        SUM(CASE WHEN is_moving = 1 THEN valid_interval_seconds ELSE 0 END) AS moving_seconds,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN is_moving = 1 THEN valid_interval_seconds ELSE 0 END) / 3600.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS moving_hours,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN is_moving = 1 THEN valid_interval_seconds ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
            / NULLIF(SUM(valid_interval_seconds), 0) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS moving_share,
        SUM(CASE WHEN interval_seconds > max_sample_gap_seconds THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS large_gap_count,
        CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS queue_row_count,
        CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS queue_distinct_job_count,
        CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS queue_distinct_amr_count,
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(40)) AS min_enqueued_at,
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(40)) AS max_enqueued_at,
        CASE
            WHEN GROUPING(metric_date) = 1 AND GROUPING(amr_id) = 1 THEN 1
            WHEN GROUPING(metric_date) = 1 THEN 2
            ELSE 3
        END AS sort_key
    FROM ##robot_status_intervals_full
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (),
        (amr_id),
        (metric_date, amr_id)
    )
),
queue_agg AS (
    SELECT
        'queue_status' AS result_type,
        CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS metric_date,
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(100)) AS amr_id,
        CAST(q.status AS NVARCHAR(100)) AS queue_status,
        CAST(NULL AS DATETIME2(3)) AS analysis_start,
        CAST(NULL AS DATETIME2(3)) AS analysis_end,
        CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS status_sample_count,
        CAST(NULL AS INT) AS robot_count,
        CAST(NULL AS INT) AS observed_seconds,
        CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS observed_hours,
        CAST(NULL AS INT) AS idle_seconds,
        CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS idle_hours,
        CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS idle_share,
        CAST(NULL AS INT) AS moving_seconds,
        CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS moving_hours,
        CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS moving_share,
        CAST(NULL AS INT) AS large_gap_count,
        COUNT_BIG(*) AS queue_row_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT q.job_id) AS queue_distinct_job_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT q.AMR_id) AS queue_distinct_amr_count,
        CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), MIN(q.enqueued_at), 126) AS min_enqueued_at,
        CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), MAX(q.enqueued_at), 126) AS max_enqueued_at,
        4 AS sort_key
    FROM [ODS].[AMR_Queue] q
    GROUP BY q.status
)
SELECT *
FROM status_agg
UNION ALL
SELECT *
FROM queue_agg
ORDER BY
    sort_key,
    metric_date,
    idle_seconds DESC,
    amr_id,
    queue_row_count DESC;

================================================================
END FILE: outputs/robot_ods_export_from_global_temp.sql

BEGIN FILE: outputs/robot_ods_idle_travel_queue_single_result.sql
================================================================
USE IOT2020;

/*
    Single-result ODS idle / travel / queue analytics.
    Read-only. No business table writes. No credentials required in the script.

    This version is intended for DataGrip result-grid export:
      - result_type = overall
      - result_type = robot_total
      - result_type = robot_daily
      - result_type = queue_status

    Metric definitions:
      - idle_seconds: valid interval where ABS(robot_speed) <= 0.050
      - moving_seconds: valid interval where ABS(robot_speed) > 0.050
      - travel time proxy: moving_seconds
      - intervals greater than 300 seconds are excluded from duration totals

    Full history is used because analysis_start and analysis_end are NULL.
*/

WITH params AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(NULL AS DATETIME2(3)) AS requested_start,
        CAST(NULL AS DATETIME2(3)) AS requested_end,
        CAST(300 AS INT) AS max_sample_gap_seconds,
        CAST(0.050 AS DECIMAL(10,3)) AS idle_speed_threshold
),
bounds AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(p.requested_start, MIN(rsh.robot_datetime)) AS analysis_start,
        COALESCE(p.requested_end, MAX(rsh.robot_datetime)) AS analysis_end,
        p.max_sample_gap_seconds,
        p.idle_speed_threshold
    FROM params p
    CROSS JOIN [ODS].[robot_status_history] rsh
    WHERE rsh.robot_datetime IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        p.requested_start,
        p.requested_end,
        p.max_sample_gap_seconds,
        p.idle_speed_threshold
),
ordered_status AS (
    SELECT
        rsh.amr_id,
        CAST(rsh.robot_datetime AS DATE) AS metric_date,
        rsh.robot_datetime,
        rsh.pc_timestamp,
        rsh.robot_speed,
        b.analysis_start,
        b.analysis_end,
        b.max_sample_gap_seconds,
        b.idle_speed_threshold,
        LEAD(rsh.robot_datetime) OVER (
            PARTITION BY rsh.amr_id
            ORDER BY rsh.robot_datetime, rsh.pc_timestamp
        ) AS next_robot_datetime
    FROM [ODS].[robot_status_history] rsh
    CROSS JOIN bounds b
    WHERE rsh.robot_datetime >= b.analysis_start
      AND rsh.robot_datetime < b.analysis_end
      AND rsh.amr_id IS NOT NULL
),
intervals AS (
    SELECT
        amr_id,
        metric_date,
        analysis_start,
        analysis_end,
        DATEDIFF(SECOND, robot_datetime, next_robot_datetime) AS interval_seconds,
        CASE
            WHEN next_robot_datetime IS NULL THEN 0
            WHEN DATEDIFF(SECOND, robot_datetime, next_robot_datetime) <= 0 THEN 0
            WHEN DATEDIFF(SECOND, robot_datetime, next_robot_datetime) > max_sample_gap_seconds THEN 0
            ELSE DATEDIFF(SECOND, robot_datetime, next_robot_datetime)
        END AS valid_interval_seconds,
        CASE
            WHEN ABS(COALESCE(robot_speed, 0)) <= idle_speed_threshold THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_idle,
        CASE
            WHEN ABS(COALESCE(robot_speed, 0)) > idle_speed_threshold THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_moving,
        max_sample_gap_seconds
    FROM ordered_status
),
status_agg AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN GROUPING(metric_date) = 1 AND GROUPING(amr_id) = 1 THEN 'overall'
            WHEN GROUPING(metric_date) = 1 THEN 'robot_total'
            ELSE 'robot_daily'
        END AS result_type,
        CASE
            WHEN GROUPING(metric_date) = 1 THEN CAST(NULL AS DATE)
            ELSE metric_date
        END AS metric_date,
        CASE
            WHEN GROUPING(amr_id) = 1 THEN CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(100))
            ELSE CAST(amr_id AS NVARCHAR(100))
        END AS amr_id,
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(100)) AS queue_status,
        MIN(analysis_start) AS analysis_start,
        MAX(analysis_end) AS analysis_end,
        COUNT_BIG(*) AS status_sample_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT amr_id) AS robot_count,
        SUM(valid_interval_seconds) AS observed_seconds,
        CAST(SUM(valid_interval_seconds) / 3600.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS observed_hours,
        SUM(CASE WHEN is_idle = 1 THEN valid_interval_seconds ELSE 0 END) AS idle_seconds,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN is_idle = 1 THEN valid_interval_seconds ELSE 0 END) / 3600.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS idle_hours,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN is_idle = 1 THEN valid_interval_seconds ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
            / NULLIF(SUM(valid_interval_seconds), 0) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS idle_share,
        SUM(CASE WHEN is_moving = 1 THEN valid_interval_seconds ELSE 0 END) AS moving_seconds,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN is_moving = 1 THEN valid_interval_seconds ELSE 0 END) / 3600.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS moving_hours,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN is_moving = 1 THEN valid_interval_seconds ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
            / NULLIF(SUM(valid_interval_seconds), 0) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS moving_share,
        SUM(CASE WHEN interval_seconds > max_sample_gap_seconds THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS large_gap_count,
        CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS queue_row_count,
        CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS queue_distinct_job_count,
        CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS queue_distinct_amr_count,
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(40)) AS min_enqueued_at,
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(40)) AS max_enqueued_at,
        CASE
            WHEN GROUPING(metric_date) = 1 AND GROUPING(amr_id) = 1 THEN 1
            WHEN GROUPING(metric_date) = 1 THEN 2
            ELSE 3
        END AS sort_key
    FROM intervals
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (),
        (amr_id),
        (metric_date, amr_id)
    )
),
queue_agg AS (
    SELECT
        'queue_status' AS result_type,
        CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS metric_date,
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(100)) AS amr_id,
        CAST(q.status AS NVARCHAR(100)) AS queue_status,
        CAST(NULL AS DATETIME2(3)) AS analysis_start,
        CAST(NULL AS DATETIME2(3)) AS analysis_end,
        CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS status_sample_count,
        CAST(NULL AS INT) AS robot_count,
        CAST(NULL AS INT) AS observed_seconds,
        CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS observed_hours,
        CAST(NULL AS INT) AS idle_seconds,
        CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS idle_hours,
        CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS idle_share,
        CAST(NULL AS INT) AS moving_seconds,
        CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS moving_hours,
        CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS moving_share,
        CAST(NULL AS INT) AS large_gap_count,
        COUNT_BIG(*) AS queue_row_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT q.job_id) AS queue_distinct_job_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT q.AMR_id) AS queue_distinct_amr_count,
        CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), MIN(q.enqueued_at), 126) AS min_enqueued_at,
        CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), MAX(q.enqueued_at), 126) AS max_enqueued_at,
        4 AS sort_key
    FROM [ODS].[AMR_Queue] q
    GROUP BY q.status
)
SELECT *
FROM status_agg
UNION ALL
SELECT *
FROM queue_agg
ORDER BY
    sort_key,
    metric_date,
    idle_seconds DESC,
    amr_id,
    queue_row_count DESC;

================================================================
END FILE: outputs/robot_ods_idle_travel_queue_single_result.sql

BEGIN FILE: outputs/robot_ods_queue_only_summary.sql
================================================================
USE IOT2020;
SET NOCOUNT ON;

/*
    Queue-only read-only summary.
    This does not calculate queue duration because current ODS/DWD fields do not expose a reliable dequeue/end timestamp or non-null duration.
*/
SELECT
    COALESCE(CAST(q.status AS NVARCHAR(100)), '(NULL)') AS queue_status,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS queue_row_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT q.job_id) AS queue_distinct_job_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT q.AMR_id) AS queue_distinct_amr_count,
    MIN(q.enqueued_at) AS min_enqueued_at,
    MAX(q.enqueued_at) AS max_enqueued_at
FROM [ODS].[AMR_Queue] q
GROUP BY COALESCE(CAST(q.status AS NVARCHAR(100)), '(NULL)')
ORDER BY queue_row_count DESC;

================================================================
END FILE: outputs/robot_ods_queue_only_summary.sql
